AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these can be used to keep boiled water hot? (1 mark)
   A. A hot stone
   B. A metal spoon
   C. A thermos flask
   D. An open basin

2. How deep should tiny seeds be sown? (1 mark)
   A. About 30 cm
   B. As deep as a hand
   C. On top of a heap
   D. About 1 cm

3. Which of these is a small wild animal that can destroy crops? (1 mark)
   A. Cow
   B. Hen
   C. Weaver bird
   D. Goat

4. Which of these belongs to more than one group? (1 mark)
   A. Salt
   B. Sugar
   C. Water
   D. Groundnuts

5. What is a balanced meal? (1 mark)
   A. A very large meal
   B. A meal of only sweets
   C. A meal with only one kind of food
   D. A meal with foods from all the main groups in the right amounts

6. Which PPE is worn on the feet at school and in the garden? (1 mark)
   A. Gloves
   B. Overall
   C. Dust mask
   D. Canvas shoes

7. How does eating fruit help our health? (1 mark)
   A. It stops us drinking water
   B. It gives vitamins and fibre
   C. It gives only sugar and nothing else
   D. It makes us weak

8. Which of these is a sign of a healthy young fruit plant? (1 mark)
   A. Rotten stem
   B. Yellow and dry leaves
   C. Green leaves and steady growth
   D. Fallen stem

9. About how far apart may rows of tiny seeds be? (1 mark)
   A. 5 metres
   B. 10 metres
   C. 1 mm
   D. 15 to 20 cm

10. How far apart may passion fruit plants be planted? (1 mark)
   A. About 2 to 3 metres
   B. Touching
   C. 10 cm
   D. 30 metres

11. Which person is protecting wildlife? (1 mark)
   A. A person who poisons birds
   B. A hunter who sets a trap
   C. A person who burns a forest
   D. A learner who reports poaching to a wildlife officer

12. About how long is each stitch in even tacking in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. 1 metre
   B. 1 cm
   C. 10 cm
   D. 1 mm

13. Where is the neck of the bottle placed in a bottle drip system? (1 mark)
   A. In the bucket
   B. In the soil beside the plant
   C. High in a tree
   D. On the leaves

14. Which is the correct order for washing dishes? (1 mark)
   A. Any order in dirty water
   B. Greasy first
   C. Rinse only with soap
   D. Least greasy first, greasy last

15. What is thinning? (1 mark)
   A. Removing extra seedlings so the rest have room
   B. Adding more seeds
   C. Making soil thin
   D. Cutting all plants

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how an improved jiko saves fuel. (3 marks)

17. Give three reasons why a clean home is important. (3 marks)

18. Describe the first aid for a small burn. (3 marks)

19. Describe how a group can share the work of growing a fruit tree at school. (4 marks)

20. Explain what is meant by a balanced meal. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — A thermos flask
   A flask keeps water hot so it need not be boiled again.

2. D — About 1 cm
   The smaller the seed, the shallower it should be sown.

3. C — Weaver bird
   Weaver birds and other birds eat grain crops.

4. D — Groundnuts
   Groundnuts give protein and energy.

5. D — A meal with foods from all the main groups in the right amounts
   A balanced meal includes energy, body-building and protective foods.

6. D — Canvas shoes
   Canvas shoes protect feet.

7. B — It gives vitamins and fibre
   Fruits protect the body and help digestion.

8. C — Green leaves and steady growth
   Healthy plants grow green.

9. D — 15 to 20 cm
   Rows are close but leave space for weeding.

10. A — About 2 to 3 metres
   Give climbers room.

11. D — A learner who reports poaching to a wildlife officer
   Reporting poaching helps protect animals.

12. B — 1 cm
   Even tacking uses 1 cm stitches and gaps.

13. B — In the soil beside the plant
   The bottle is buried neck down near the plant.

14. D — Least greasy first, greasy last
   Water stays cleaner longer.

15. A — Removing extra seedlings so the rest have room
   Thinning gives strong plants space.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Its walls keep the heat close to the pot, so food cooks faster, and less charcoal or wood is used.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for heat close to pot, 1 mark for faster cooking, 1 mark for less fuel.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: It prevents diseases, keeps food safe, prevents accidents and looks pleasant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Put the burn under cool running clean water for at least ten minutes, cover it loosely with a clean cloth and tell an adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Make a chart with jobs such as watering, weeding, mulching and recording; take turns each week; check the plant daily; record dates of flowers and fruits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct activity or arrangement.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A meal that has foods from all the main food groups in the right amounts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for foods from all groups, 1 mark for right amounts.
